The second innovation is to offer restaurant possibilities to newcomers. Many people interested in food have a dream of opening their own restaurant. A new restaurateur must find the right location for their offering, commit to a long lease, design and install the new interior, acquire furniture, and install the equipment for a modern kitchen. Then they must find reliable suppliers, get the relevant trading licenses, and handle other officialdom. Waiters and bar staff have to be hired, and finally, they must plan and execute a campaign to advertise their restaurant. These are often huge costs before even the first plate of their delicious food is sold.

The UG Group offers a much easier entry into the restaurant business - a fully equipped kitchen in an excellent location, ready to serve.
